queries: WITH account_counts AS (SELECT a.account_id, a.customer_id, COUNT(ft.account_id) AS transaction_count FROM Accounts AS a LEFT JOIN Financial_Transactions AS ft ON ft.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id, a.customer_id), average_count AS (SELECT AVG(transaction_count * 1.0) AS value FROM account_counts), eligible AS (SELECT ac.account_id, c.town_city, ac.transaction_count FROM account_counts AS ac JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = ac.customer_id WHERE c.town_city IS NOT NULL) SELECT e.account_id, e.town_city, e.transaction_count, e.transaction_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(e.transaction_count) OVER (PARTITION BY e.town_city), 0) AS town_transaction_share, e.transaction_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(av.value, 0) AS ratio_to_average FROM eligible AS e CROSS JOIN average_count AS av ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC, e.account_id LIMIT 10
